title: 3765. Complete Prime Number

examples.explanation: Prefixes of num = 23 are 2 and 23, both are prime. Suffixes of num = 23 are 3 and 23, both are prime. All prefixes and suffixes are prime, so 23 is a Complete Prime Number and the answer is true.

Prefixes of num = 39 are 3 and 39. 3 is prime, but 39 is not prime. Suffixes of num = 39 are 9 and 39. Both 9 and 39 are not prime. At least one prefix or suffix is not prime, so 39 is not a Complete Prime Number and the answer is false.
7 is prime, so all its prefixes and suffixes are prime and the answer is true.
